Accounts closed within 14 days of opening are free; closure between 14 days and 12 months costs 500 rupees; closure after 12 months is free. Kosh Basic is a Basic Savings Bank Deposit Account with no minimum balance requirement and up to four free withdrawals a month. [savings_account.md]

Turnaround times: Failed ATM transactions where cash was not dispensed are reversed within 5 working days. Daily limits: The default daily ATM withdrawal limit is 50,000 rupees and the default daily purchase limit is 1,00,000 rupees. [grievance_redressal.md] [debit_card.md]
Personal loans: Personal loans are available from 50,000 rupees to 25 lakh rupees for tenures of 12 to 60 months. The processing fee is up to 2 percent of the loan amount. [loans_faq.md]

Video KYC: Full KYC can be completed online through video KYC with a KoshBank official between 9 am and 9 pm on all days. Accounts opened with OTP-based e-KYC are limited to a balance of 1 lakh rupees until full KYC is completed. [kyc.md] [savings_account.md]
Transaction limits: The UPI limit is 1,00,000 rupees per transaction and 1,00,000 rupees per day. [upi.md]

Blocking a lost or stolen card: If your debit card is lost or stolen, block it immediately through the KoshBank app (Cards > Block card), through net banking, or by calling the 24x7 helpline at 1800-000-0000. [debit_card.md]
